mapper.select: select from attachment_files where business_record_id = #{businessRecordId} and deleted_at is null and business_record_status not in ('UNPUBLISHED','INACTIVE') order by uploaded_at desc, file_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

mapper.update: update attachment_files set deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, delete_reason = #{deleteReason} where file_id = #{fileId} and deleted_at is null and business_record_status != 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: insert into attachment_delete_history (file_id, delete_method, reason, deleted_by) values (#{fileId}, 'LOGICAL', #{reason}, #{deletedBy})
